igrf: degree13; dipole: actual degree1 Gauss coefficients; aligned-dipole: axis-aligned fixture with specified equatorial strength.
Coefficient interpolation epoch, 1900-2030; independent of the chemistry UTC clock.

Geographic APEX longitude at domain centre, not geographic longitude at HK350km. Automatic target is geodetic22.3N114.2E350km.

User physical L0 longitude cells; >=4 and <=512, subject to canonical size limits.
User physical L0 apex-height cells; >=4 and <=512. Three-level MPI rank count cannot exceed this value.
Whole-conjugate along-field segments, 16-1024; never refined by transverse AMR.
Lowest tube apex spherical altitude; must exceed base altitude.
Highest tube apex spherical altitude, above minimum and <=3000.
Both conjugate endpoints at spherical altitude above6371.2km radius; 80-150.
Maximum RK4 tracing step, 0.1-20; tracing also reduces steps near the base.
Construct/load geometry and return before plasma evolution on AMR path.
Native-ABI canonical geometry cache; exact parameter/input/code/ABI matching required.

Initial physical molecular E population, peak110km scale12km. Fixed without night module; initially NO+ with night module.
Seed fractional amplitude; absolute value <1. Positive values make a depletion in the configured envelope.
Spherical-altitude seed envelope centre.
Positive vertical seed envelope width; see exact initialization equation in methods.
Nonnegative horizontal seed width; zero selects the alternate wavelength pattern, not an eastward displacement.
Seed apex longitude, strictly inside the regional domain; explicit setting is incompatible with periodic-x.
Fixed Ti+Te used by O+ parallel pressure/sound speed. Night module requires exact consistency with chem-Ti+chem-Te.
Aligned-dipole equatorial amplitude; positive; does not replace all coefficients in ordinary degree-one dipole mode.
Include field-aligned transport/momentum. Zero is a deliberately reduced physical case.
Order of the bounded along-field face reconstruction; distinct from transverse PDM4.
rusanov or relaxation. Night module requires relaxation; includes collision/pressure/gravity fitted mass flux.
muscl or pdm4; explicit selection is recommended. PDM4 is a four-cell volume-moment cubic stencil with limiter.
PDM limiter correction bound2*beta*upstream difference; supported0-10. beta=0 reduces to donor-cell at the limiter.
Retain integrated Hall conductivity cross terms; disabling changes physics.
Longitude periodicity; physical branch requires aligned dipole, zero imposed E and no localized horizontal seed.
Regional open longitude particle boundary and polarization d_xi(phi)=0 side condition; this is NOT zero total normal current.
Open particle boundaries at transverse apex-height extremes; required for external driver cases.
Open particle boundaries at both along-field endpoints; otherwise reflective/closed.
Prescribed constant eastward electric field, added through mapped potential; excludes CSV driver. AMR driver requires regional nonperiodic and open-apex geometry.
time_s,east_V_m strictly increasing from0 with coverage through absolute end; stage interpolation and step landing on knots.
PETSc backend for uniform reference path. AMR inherently requires PETSc even though this static-path selector defaults0.
Requested true potential infinity-residual scale; positive and <.01; AMR accepts <=1.05*rtol after explicit residual computation.
Positive and <=.45; initial proposal uses0.9*cfl/rate and stage acceptance uses cfl. Teaching/qualification cases explicitly use.25.
Positive maximum attempted step; all active levels/species share the accepted dt, with no subcycling.
Absolute elapsed-model stop time. On restart this is not additional duration.
Positive frame/checkpoint interval; initial and final frames also written. Not a physics timescale or an AMR interval.
Absolute step counter limit, including history restored by restart.
Progress-print step interval; zero disables periodic progress lines but not essential diagnostics.
New run directory; an existing metadata.json is rejected to preserve prior outputs.
Native AMR checkpoint or explicitly supported uniform-state import; physical/numerical signatures must match.
Molecular ESFNIT02 paired with exact native checkpoint; required for night continuation.
none,fixed,fine,dynamic select the AMR backend. There is no literal static enum; omitting the option selects the uniform reference path.
Number of PHYSICAL levels. Three requires structure criterion and nonzero along-field slab size.
esf,translation,potential,remap. Latter three are verification fixtures, not physical ESF forecasts.
legacy percentile/depletion or structure local solution-based detector. Released examples explicitly select structure.
total or represented; represented removes a fitted local background-shaped component for detection only, never from evolved density.
Along-field segment grouping for density tags. Zero means column-wide legacy layout; nonzero must divide ns and requires structure. Qualification uses4.
Maximum tag-check interval. Accumulated transverse travel can trigger earlier checks; not a fixed actual regrid period.
Transverse root-cell buffer around requested structure; 0-16. Qualification uses1.
Additive canonical-field work estimate in root-row MPI partition planner; does not change physical equations.
Use cached constrained COO assembly; zero selects the reference element assembly algebra.
Refine threshold for normalized detector gradient; must be >=positive off threshold.
Lower keep-refined gradient threshold, providing spatial hysteresis.
Refine threshold for normalized density Hessian norm.
Lower keep-refined curvature threshold.
Threshold for interval-scaled drift curvature divided by local spacing; keep-refined threshold is half.
Integrated conductivity-tensor curvature threshold for FIELD requests, half when already refined.
Physical quiet and minimum residence time before coarsening; qualified production uses60. Zero-hold simultaneous coarsening is not qualified; see known limitations.
Advect a material seed-protection marker and prevent under-resolved protected wavelengths. Fresh perturbed structure runs need explicit positive seed wavelength when enabled.
Shortest declared protected seed wavelength, not inferred from grid. Sampling target32 cells/wavelength; unresolved locations are reported.
Additional protected wavelength when resolved walls/branches are tagged; zero disables this requirement.
Declared weak-seed amplitude used in protection/information-loss tolerance; distinct from density seeding amplitude.
Legacy detector depletion refinement threshold; below off threshold and positive.
Legacy keep-refined depletion threshold, <1. Not used as a density floor.
Legacy quiet-check count before coarsening; structure detector instead uses quiet-seconds.
none,flat,wall,tip,fork,weak synthetic detector fixtures; explicitly separate these from scientific seeding.
Enable the full transported molecular module, not just local chemistry. Requires physical segmented structure AMR, neutral input, UTC, positive E peak and consistent temperatures.
With night module on, zero disables only reactions; NO+/O2+ still transport. It is not a fixed-reservoir switch.
Five-column height table or strict spatial ESFNEU01 grid; physical values must cover the entire canonical conjugate geometry.
height_m,nu_O_s1,nu_e_s1; strictly increasing, positive and fully covering geometry. Without it use documented idealized analytic rates.
Absolute UTC at model time0, required for night module; 2000-2100 range checked. Not HKT, LST or MLT.
Fixed ion temperature for all night species, 200-5000 and applicable reaction-fit range.
Fixed electron temperature for night closure, 200-5000. Ti+Te must equal temperature-sum.
